name: How long does it take to remove a kitchen wall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove a kitchen wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for removing a kitchen wall depends on its complexity. A non-load-bearing wall with no utilities might be removed in 1-3 days, including demolition and basic debris cleanup. If the wall is load-bearing, requires new structural support, or contains plumbing and electrical, the project can extend to 1-2 weeks. This includes time for engineering assessments, permit acquisition, demolition, installation of new supports, and initial patch-up work. Final finishing, like flooring or painting, will add additional time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing a kitchen wall typically takes 1-3 days for non-load-bearing walls and 1-2 weeks for load-bearing walls, depending on complexity and utility relocation.
